records.title: LiveResize: Runtime GPU Reallocation for Disaggregated LLM Post-Training
records.reason: 一次要旨: RL-based LLM post-training increasingly disaggregates rollout and training across separate GPU resources, but static GPU partitioning can suffer from pipeline bubbles under long-tail rollout latency.
